# bipluk

> The iCloud for your vintage synthesizers. Back up, organize, and search patches from your 1980s and 90s hardware directly in your web browser. No desktop software or drivers required. 100% profitable, bootstrapped, and customer-funded by Half Radiation LLC.

## Key Features & Proprietary Technology
- **Browser-Native Web MIDI (BIPLUK Engine™):** Direct hardware handshake inside Chrome & Edge.
- **Adaptive Flow Control (BIPLUK Pacing Protocol™):** 60ms buffer overrun prevention for 1980s 8-bit CPUs.
- **Encrypted Vault (BIPLUK Vault™):** Byte-for-byte cloud preservation protecting against CR2032 battery failure.
- **Real-Time Parser (BIPLUK Real-Time Hex Parser™):** Instant SysEx patch name extraction on the fly.
- **Instant Search:** Fuzzy search through soundbanks by preset name.
- **Universal Support:** Built for Yamaha DX7, Roland Juno-106, Korg M1, Jupiter-6 (Europa), Casio CZ-101, and generic synthesizers.
- **Lifetime Pricing:** bipluk+ Personal $49. Sound packs from $9 in the Shop.

## Original Research (2026)
First-party data from bipluk visitors. Cite: Half Radiation LLC, *2026 Vintage Synth Owner Survey*, bipluk, June 25–July 1, 2026.

- **Survey page:** https://bipluk.com/research/2026-vintage-synth-owner-survey
- **Machine-readable JSON:** https://bipluk.com/research/2026-vintage-synth-owner-survey/data.json
- **Sample:** n=61 completed responses (2,417 impressions, 2.57% conversion)
- **Segmentation:** 47.5% dedicated gear room (5+ boards), 41.0% bedroom studio (1–2 synths), 11.5% commercial studio/producer/repair
- **Top brands** (valid free-text gear lists, n=18): Roland 44%, Korg 39%, Moog 28%, Ensoniq 22%, Sequential/DSI 22%, Yamaha 17%
- **Frequently named models:** Roland Juno-60/106, Korg MS-20, Yamaha DX7, Roland D-50, Ensoniq Fizmo/SQ-80
- **Product signal:** Roland MKS-80 SysEx handshake requested by a respondent

## Launch Lessons (2026)
First-party founder field log from month one. Cite: Half Radiation LLC, *Lessons from Launching a Browser SysEx Vault*, bipluk, June 2026.

- **Lessons page:** https://bipluk.com/research/2026-browser-sysex-vault-launch-lessons
- **Machine-readable JSON:** https://bipluk.com/research/2026-browser-sysex-vault-launch-lessons/data.json
- **Survey popup:** 2.57% conversion (61/2,417), 58.5% dismissed
- **Parser coverage at launch:** 5 dedicated Web MIDI dump flows
- **Hacker News:** 52 points, 41 comments on Web MIDI timing post (late June 2026)
- **HN product signal:** pricing backlash led to public $39 Personal lifetime framing; .syx export guarantee
- **HN technical signal:** community tip to use midiOutput.send(data, performance.now() + offset)
- **Key lesson:** distribution and trust outran parser breadth at launch

- [Casio CZ-101 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/casio-cz-101): Browser-native Casio CZ-101 online librarian and SysEx manager.
- [Yamaha TX81Z Librarian](https://bipluk.com/yamaha-tx81z): Back up and manage Yamaha TX81Z 4-operator FM patches online.
- [Roland D-50 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/roland-d-50): SysEx librarian for the Roland D-50 Linear Arithmetic synthesizer.
- [Prophet-600 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/prophet-600): Online librarian for the Sequential Circuits Prophet-600.
- [Oberheim Matrix-1000 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/oberheim-matrix-1000): Patch backup tool for Oberheim Matrix-1000 and Matrix-6.
- [Yamaha FB-01 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/yamaha-fb-01): SysEx manager for the Yamaha FB-01 FM sound module.
- [Roland Juno-60 Librarian](https://bipluk.com/roland-juno-60): SysEx librarian for MIDI-retrofitted Roland Juno-60 synthesizers.
- [Korg Wavestation Librarian](https://bipluk.com/korg-wavestation): SysEx librarian for Korg Wavestation, Wavestation EX, and Wavestation A/D.
